name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

angles.text: You can learn to make field tools such as the sharpening wheel, taking your craft beyond city forges to help allies in the wild.
Keen weapons matter in battle, and a sharpening wheel at camp helps you keep your edge on an expedition.
A sharp dagger is essential to your trade, so a camp sharpening wheel is welcome between field contracts.
As a dwarf, you can find Kharanos in the snowy foothills of Dun Morogh. Its smiths keep cold steel sharp for the road.

faq.answer: Tognus Flintfire teaches blacksmithing in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh. He trains smiths who have shown skill in their trade, teaching them to make gear for campsites.
A sharpening wheel is a portable tool made by blacksmiths. At camp, it gives warriors, rogues and other weapon bearers a place to hone their blades in the field.
Warriors and rogues depend on sharp weapons in battle. A sharpening wheel lets them tend their blades, axes and daggers while traveling far from town forges.
faq.q: Why do warriors and rogues care about the Sharpening Wheel?

faq.answer: Kharanos lies southwest of Ironforge in the snowy peaks of Dun Morogh. Travelers, miners and craftsmen use the settlement as a stopping place while crossing the mountain passes.

aliases: when can i learn sharpening wheel
faq.answer: Show basic skill at the anvil, and Tognus Flintfire will teach you to make campsite gear. Then you can learn to forge the portable wheel.
faq.q: What is required to learn this camping item?

faq.answer: Blacksmiths make camping tools to help adventuring parties beyond settled towns. A portable sharpening wheel lets companions maintain their weapons under the open sky, without returning to a city forge.
faq.q: Why do blacksmiths craft camping items?

sections.body: You are sent to Kharanos to learn how a smith can serve far from a town forge. There, skilled hands turn raw metal into tools for camp. A blade kept keen is ready for the long road.
sections.title: Field Maintenance for the Open Road

sections.body: In Kharanos, Tognus Flintfire teaches capable smiths to make a sharpening wheel. Set one beside your campsite and warriors and rogues can grind nicks from their weapons and hone dull edges before the next march.
sections.title: The Master of Kharanos

summary: Smiths bound for the wilderness are sent to Kharanos to learn from Tognus Flintfire. He teaches them to make a portable sharpening wheel for keeping weapons keen at camp.
